body.purpose: Primary interface copy and navigation labels.

shadows.name: device-frame
shadows.purpose: Lifts a presented device from the stage.

shadows.name: device-shadow
shadows.purpose: Subtle product-scale depth for displayed hardware.

motion.name: lens-lift
motion.purpose: Lifts and settles a liquid lens on press or selection.

motion.name: navigation
motion.purpose: Morphs navigation bars and page transitions.

components.name: Glass
components.description: A refractive glass surface whose shape adapts to its backing content.
components.css: .ds-glass { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-width: 96px; min-height: 44px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.28); border-radius: 22px; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.24); color: #000; -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(18px); backdrop-filter: blur(18px); }

components.name: GlassContainer
components.description: A container that merges neighboring glass members into a shared adaptive surface.
components.css: .ds-glass-container { display: inline-flex; gap: 8px; padding: 4px; border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(118, 118, 128, 0.12); } .ds-glass-member { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 36px; padding: 0 14px; border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.72); color: #000; }

components.name: Vibrant
components.description: Palette-toned text or icon ink that remains legible over variable glass backing.
components.css: .ds-vibrant { display: inline-block; color: #007aff; font: 500 15px/1.25 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Button
components.description: A system control available in glass, prominent, or clear variants and automatic, capsule, rectangle, or circle shapes.
components.css: .ds-button { min-height: 22px; padding: 7px 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: #007aff; color: #fff; font: 400 17px/22px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-button:hover { background: #006ee6; } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgb(0 136 255 / 0.65); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-button:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Toggle
components.description: A 63px by 28px switch whose thumb lifts into a liquid lens during manipulation.
components.css: .ds-toggle { position: relative; width: 63px; height: 28px; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: #34c759; cursor: pointer; } .ds-toggle span { position: absolute; right: 2px; top: 2px; width: 24px; height: 24px; border-radius: 50%; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18); } .ds-toggle:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgb(0 136 255 / 0.65); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Slider
components.description: A 6px track with a lifted 37px by 24px thumb, step snapping, ticks, and tintable fill.
components.css: .ds-slider { position: relative; width: 260px; height: 31px; } .ds-slider::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; top: 12.5px; height: 6px; border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(118, 118, 128, 0.12); } .ds-slider span { position: absolute; left: calc(65% - 18.5px); top: 3.5px; width: 37px; height: 24px; border-radius: 12px; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18); }

components.name: Picker
components.description: A selection control that presents options and a moving glass selection treatment.
components.css: .ds-picker { display: inline-flex; padding: 3px; border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(118, 118, 128, 0.12); } .ds-picker button { min-height: 32px; padding: 0 14px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; color: #000; } .ds-picker [aria-checked='true'] { background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08); }

components.name: Toolbar
components.description: A morphing glass command bar composed from grouped toolbar items.
components.css: .ds-toolbar { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 52px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.24); border-radius: 26px; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.72); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px); backdrop-filter: blur(20px); } .ds-toolbar button { min-height: 36px; border: 0; border-radius: 18px; background: transparent; color: #007aff; }

components.name: TabView
components.description: A navigation view with glass tabs and spring-matched selection movement.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; width: fit-content; height: 62px; align-items: center; gap: 2px; padding: 4px; border-radius: 62px; background: rgba(118, 118, 128, 0.12); } .ds-tabs button { min-width: 84px; height: 54px; border: 0; border-radius: 62px; background: transparent; color: #000; } .ds-tabs .is-selected { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.84); box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08); }

components.name: SearchBar
components.description: A glass search field with native placeholder behavior and morphing presentation.
components.css: .ds-search { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; width: 260px; height: 44px; box-sizing: border-box; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(118, 118, 128, 0.12); } .ds-search:focus-within { outline: 3px solid rgb(0 136 255 / 0.65); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-search input { min-width: 0; flex: 1; border: 0; outline: 0; background: transparent; color: #000; font: 400 17px/22px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-search input::placeholder { color: rgba(60, 60, 67, 0.6); }

components.name: Menu
components.description: A glass action menu with items, sections, dividers, and optional submenus.
components.css: .ds-menu { display: flex; flex-direction: column; width: 220px; padding: 8px; border-radius: 18px; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.92); box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18); } .ds-menu button { min-height: 40px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; background: transparent; text-align: left; } .ds-menu button:hover { background: rgba(118, 118, 128, 0.12); } .ds-menu hr { width: 100%; border: 0; border-top: 1px solid rgba(60, 60, 67, 0.12); }

components.name: ContextMenu
components.description: A context-triggered glass menu positioned around its source element.
components.css: .ds-context-menu { display: flex; flex-direction: column; width: 180px; gap: 2px; padding: 8px; border-radius: 18px; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.94); box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18); } .ds-context-menu button { min-height: 40px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; background: transparent; text-align: left; }

components.name: EditMenu
components.description: An editing action menu for overflow and contextual text actions.
components.css: .ds-edit-menu { display: inline-flex; gap: 4px; padding: 6px; border-radius: 18px; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.94); box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18); } .ds-edit-menu button { min-height: 36px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; background: transparent; }

components.name: Sheet
components.description: A bottom glass sheet with large, medium, or fractional detents and drag dismissal.
components.css: .ds-sheet { position: relative; box-sizing: border-box; min-height: 240px; padding: 28px; border-radius: 34px 34px 0 0; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.94); box-shadow: 0 -12px 32px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12); } .ds-sheet-indicator { width: 36px; height: 5px; margin: -10px auto 20px; border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(60, 60, 67, 0.3); } .ds-sheet h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 22px; line-height: 26px; }

components.name: Alert
components.description: A modal alert with title, message, optional fields, and action buttons.
components.css: .ds-alert { width: 270px; box-sizing: border-box; padding: 18px 16px 12px; border-radius: 34px; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.94); text-align: center; box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18); } .ds-alert h2 { margin: 0 0 6px; font-size: 17px; } .ds-alert p { margin: 0 0 12px; color: rgba(60, 60, 67, 0.6); font-size: 15px; } .ds-alert button { width: 100%; min-height: 44px; border: 0; border-radius: 22px; background: rgba(118, 118, 128, 0.12); color: #007aff; }

components.name: ConfirmationDialog
components.description: An anchored glass confirmation popover with title, message, cancel, and action choices.
components.css: .ds-confirmation { width: 240px; box-sizing: border-box; padding: 18px 16px 12px; border-radius: 34px; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.94); text-align: center; box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18); } .ds-confirmation h2 { margin: 0 0 6px; font-size: 17px; } .ds-confirmation p { margin: 0 0 12px; color: rgba(60, 60, 67, 0.6); font-size: 15px; } .ds-confirmation button { min-height: 40px; margin: 2px; border: 0; border-radius: 20px; background: rgba(118, 118, 128, 0.12); color: #007aff; }

narrative.overview:
Liquid Glass Spaces translates the visual and behavioral language of a modern operating system into a refractive, touch-responsive surface system. The implementation feels optically physical rather than purely graphic: controls can become lenses when pressed, fills can swell or settle, and navigation moves through spatial continuity instead of abrupt page swaps.

The site balances Apple-like density with generous presentation. Light and dark schemes are complete, not inverted sketches. Neutral surfaces carry most of the interface, blue appears as the focused action and state color, and glass is reserved for spatial interaction rather than used as decoration on every panel.
keyCharacteristics: Refractive glass with stable typography and direct touch affordances
Restrained light surfaces and true-black dark surfaces
System-like density on controls, generous rhythm on editorial sections

rules.name: The Accent Rarity Rule
rules.body: Blue is for actionable, active, and state-bearing elements; it is not a decorative wash.

rules.name: The Native Rhythm Rule
rules.body: Use platform-native font names and negative tracking only for large display text; keep interface copy untracked and highly legible.

rules.name: The One Rail Rule
rules.body: Editorial sections share the same content rail; a component demo may break containment only when it is demonstrating device or material scale.

rules.name: The State-Driven Lift Rule
rules.body: Elevation appears as a response to manipulation or focus, not as a default card ornament.

rules.name: The Soft-But-Defined Rule
rules.body: Corners are rounded enough to feel tactile, but borders and fill contrast remain restrained and precise.

dos: Do keep page backgrounds neutral and reserve blue for action-bearing states.
Do use SF Pro system font stacks before introducing a custom typeface.
Do use spring or damped motion for spatial state changes.
Do preserve complete light and dark palettes rather than relying on only a CSS filter.
Do use 26px card radius and capsule-shaped controls where they match the demonstrated components.
donts: Don't add ambient shadows to every card or panel.
Don't use blue as a decorative background or oversized neutral fill.
Don't use hard page transitions where navigation can preserve spatial continuity.
Don't replace native system sizes with arbitrary global typography scales.
Don't use a decorative glass effect without a corresponding interactive or structural role.
